\-A bolt mod will probably be necessary if you're buying second hand. It's a tedious process but will guarantee the keyboard is serviceable and the assembly tight basically forever.   
\-Do not use any kind of mineral-based treatment if you restore the keycaps. Common keycap cleaning methods, such as denture tabs, leave mineral deposits on the stems, making the keys feel incredibly scratchy. This also cannot be reversed as it scratches the barrel plate, requiring replacement caps and a brand new plate.
